long_term_direction: Bullish bias into 2027, but not a near-term entry signal
summary: Gold is near $3,567 after a sharp selloff and rebound attempt. Rate-hike expectations, sticky inflation, a stronger dollar and elevated yields are pressuring it; central-bank demand and risk-off uncertainty are longer-term supports. Holiday-thin trading means price confirmation is essential.
